goal: Assess evidence visibility and actual retry causes in the one ordinary Attica run using 48k.
registration: Analysis plan recorded during the run after the first 692 summary events and 23 review responses were read. This is not a pre-registered end-to-end randomized comparison.
cohort: Every completed L2 RESULT review with a transport block whose 48k rendering is reconstructed exactly, including omission count and provenance scope; enumerate exclusions. Inventory all other reviews separately, including plans and L3.
measurements: retained latest command identities and outcome status
partial versus complete excerpts; retained inspected reads/browser observations
recorded verdict and concrete refusal cause
missing-at-24k but present-at-48k evidence relevant to each refusal
time, model calls, tool calls and subscription-equivalent cost between refusal and recovery, labelled for concurrent work
final run outcome and independently checked saved source/build/history integrity
guards: Use the same pinned selector and observation set for both caps; change only the cap.
Match actual 48k visible lines and omission count before including a reconstruction.
A retained command or partial excerpt does not prove assertions, freshness or correctness.
A counterfactual projection does not demonstrate the verdict a model would issue at 24k.
Older runs changed engine/source versions, so cross-run differences are confounded.
No new paid model calls while this run is active; no new product run, engine patch, client acceptance, publication or live-site traffic.
No broad rawtrace/artifact exports or bypasses; bounded MCP reads and host-local numeric projections only.
